scope.description: Whole blender application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Mesh and scene modelling, materials, lighting/cameras, rendering, animation, rigging, sculpting, simulation and compositing.

coverage.rationale: Scene production now spans editable assets/hierarchy, object/bone motion, rigs/skin, curated shader/procedural/compositor graphs, bounded rigid-body/cloth and evaluated exchange. Most families remain partial; broader linked-library/cache asset reuse, richer simulation/cache workflows, sculpt/paint/Grease Pencil and sequencing/tracking remain unfinished. This is an uncertain strategic breadth estimate, not a measured API percentage. Reusable role-bound action/NLA clips and relative/absolute morph authoring now extend animation, with native asset fidelity for ordinary action strips. The conservative whole-application estimate remains unchanged until broader missing families are addressed. Reusable typed shader, geometry and compositor group interfaces now include nested graphs and checked native parameter editing; the remaining strategic family map is unchanged. Selected native scene/layer collection carriers now preserve native ownership, nested instances and sharing; linked-library overrides and source render-layer transplantation remain unfinished. Typed scientific mesh fields and multiple named UV projection/unwrap/packing now extend texture/data workflows; sculpt/paint/baking/UDIM and richer topology remain required. The conservative whole-application estimate is unchanged. Typed Object/Collection resources and selected-asset-part compositions extend bounded procedural workflows; imported procedural topology remains incomplete. Finite mesh selections and ordered topology edits now support enclosure, bridge and halfspace workflows; broader mesh operators, topology data interpolation, sculpt and paint remain incomplete. No family-wide completion follows from these bounded cases. Editable classic multi-spline Bezier/NURBS controls, planar fills and section/taper dependencies extend modelling without closing broader curve editing, surfaces, hair or implicit modelling. Subjective scores remain unchanged. Typed Cycles/EEVEE/Workbench engine intent, display transforms and distinct material/object/mesh-attribute colours extend rendering; broader rendering, probe/cache, OCIO and pass/output families remain incomplete. Conservative subjective estimates remain unchanged. Bounded captured-image Workbench previews now separate display image and active UV from shader appearance; painting/baking/UDIM remain incomplete. Subjective estimates are unchanged. Named DATA surface layouts and exact-data Object palettes extend bounded face/spline/text materials and linked appearance. The subjective whole-application estimate remains unchanged; broader shader/paint/bake/UDIM and material animation remain required. Typed layered artist surfaces and shared image/UV/normal intent extend reusable material workflows without changing the conservative subjective breadth score; texture painting, baking, UDIM and additional shader families remain incomplete. Finite public render bundles add named view layers, CPU scientific EXR planes and Cryptomatte, managed PNG/EXR output, logical Material/World AOV taps and captured collection masks. Cycles Freestyle adds bounded technical lines. Explicit rigid-packed and cloth-packed/disk requests add freshly reconstructed all-frame cache verification. Whole Blender remains incomplete.

scope.description: Typed mesh/scene production and reusable inferred-pivot product presentation, editable procedural materials/motion/rigs and checked frame publications.
scope.denominator: Intent and reusable domain decisions within implemented scene-production workflows; excluded and missing application families remain in whole-application coverage.

abstraction.rationale: Named scene resources, semantic channels and graph sockets compose reusable workflows, while inferred-pivot turntables lower product presentation into editable controls and verified outputs. Expert node/rig/physics controls still require native domain knowledge. Direct scene-production input removes authored DAG scaffolding, and complete packed native assets retain editable hierarchy, material and child motion. Motion roles decouple clips from object identities, explicit reference poses and normalized morph progress remove native slot/timing/Key spacing plumbing. Shared typed node interfaces remove native interface IDs, per-domain constructor plumbing and repeated graph definitions. Explicit scene/layer selection and inferred unambiguous choices replace manual append/reparent/flatten plumbing with a verified native asset carrier. Mesh-domain fields unify constant/dense/sparse data, canonical edge ordering and typed shader/procedural access; explicit copy/shared prototype ownership and semantic source-name selection prevent accidental per-instance/shared writes. Current-stage semantic selections and explicit data-loss/ownership policies replace operator selection-mode and mutable pre-edit witness plumbing for bounded mesh edits. Typed spline controls unify rational weights, tangent policies, named profile/taper dependencies and sampling budgets without authoring RNA paths or arbitrary execution. Engine-specific unions reject ineffective settings; independent display, shader, Object and attribute colours express technical presentation without RNA keys. Captured-source reconstruction separates input authority from editable output readbacks while reproducing authorised scene overlays. Independent typed display-image selection and closed pinned-file consumers avoid native paint-slot or file-reference plumbing. Logical material roles, disjoint semantic regions and separate DATA-layout/Object-palette ownership remove native slot-index and per-instance sharing plumbing while retaining editable materials and source-authoritative verification. Artist finish layers and local named sampler/channel roles compile reviewed native graphs; one stored UV transform can drive base/ORM/tangent normals without exposing native node/socket plumbing. Logical layer/owner/pass references, reusable owner-local taps and explicit cache consumers compose with existing authored scene intent; no native property dictionary or executable authoring escape is added.

limitations: Important stable Blender families remain unfinished as listed in docs/blender-capabilities.md; no strategic completion or near-total API coverage is claimed.
Most catalogues are curated subsets. Native node constructor/readback coverage does not prove every graph effect; physics replay is bounded serial acceptance without portable baked caches.
Editorial estimates have low confidence and no exhaustive API denominator; native qualification and runtime availability remain separate axes.

Typed mesh attributes and UV mapping broaden supported scene production; whole-Blender completion remains open, and independent pixel-gap checks cover the documented fixture/solver matrix rather than arbitrary UV polygons.
Resource admission conservatively considers reachable pointer defaults/overrides; imported arbitrary node/cache/volume resources need broader reviewed bounds.
Source numeric topology animation uses conservative key/Bezier envelopes; driven, layered/NLA or curve-modifier topology needs a reviewed explicit bound.
Mesh editing is bounded deterministic geometry replay; general bevel/knife/dissolve/subdivide, unequal/open loop bridging and existing UV/custom-normal/weight/morph interpolation remain gaps.
Curve/builtin-font source bounds include render resolution; richer spline/profile/taper and surface modelling still require broader authoring and native acceptance.
Renderer verification is scoped to recorded cases; final integration and independent whole-adaptor review remain pending. Whole Blender remains incomplete.

Texture painting/baking, broader material animation and MatCap flip intent/readback, captured custom OCIO/LUTs, EEVEE probe/cache authoring remain incomplete; finite named render layers/AOV/EXR bundles are now available under the declared source and decoding constraints. General verification does not independently rerender arbitrary images.

Named surface material layouts are bounded to Mesh faces, classic splines and Unicode text-character ranges, with finite selector scan work and owner/element readback budgets. Grease Pencil materials, broader shader catalogues and paint/bake/UDIM remain incomplete. Independent integration acceptance is required.

Fresh source reconstruction now binds imported material geometry inputs, including UV/colour selections, split normals, texture space, owned morph/Action channels and render-only modifier configuration. Geometry drivers, legacy Actions and texture/ORCO mesh overrides still require further typed contracts. This source-fidelity boundary is not arbitrary-image rerender equivalence or completed shader/PBR authoring.

Reserved native selection flags are presentation only when unqueried. Finite reserved literal Attribute names bind fresh stored/evaluated flags regardless of the current query mode, because captured layered Actions can switch Object to Geometry on later frames. Retained captured meshes and Object/Collection procedural dependencies share conservative query propagation without changing persisted asset-fidelity/v2; this does not prove arbitrary-image rerender equivalence.

Artist PBR has accepted scoped source, native, Studio and installed-package qualification; the three-feature closeout requires its own current combined integration gates. General shader-coordinate Jacobian correction, render-time bounds, SSS convergence oracles and whole-Blender completion are not claimed.
Native UVsphere producer indices are now deterministic; older allocation-dependent packets can require a NEW trusted-input run. Exact source topology authority remains mandatory.
CPU built-in OSL is qualified on the fixed runtime; OptiX OSL requires available supported hardware. Authored Script nodes, shader code and untyped RNA are unavailable.

Fresh scene-render context reconstruction binds hidden bounce/optics/output settings and numeric Attribute RNA lookup candidates. This requires a configured fixed Blender runtime for public saved-scene verification, including a plain DAG without explicit materials; native context is not authorised by refreshed readbacks.

Native Smart magnification is qualified; adaptive minification and portable mip-cache ownership remain OPEN. Large tiled-image probes alias with packed resources and native-generated unpacked texture caches; no area-filtering guarantee is claimed.

Legacy Curve/Font render data and global saved time/camera markers/gravity are freshly reconstructed; non-mesh curve shape-key dependencies still need a reviewed mapping and are refused. This adds no curve-morph authoring coverage.
Cycles 8-bit sRGB image sampling can lose substantial colour precision near zero alpha; encoded-byte colour fidelity is not guaranteed. EEVEE and Non-Color data use their distinct native paths.

Native geometry drivers, including simple expressions that work in Blender library append, remain refused by the material-input dependency contract; bake supported Action channels before asset reuse. Classic Curve point/handle selection and hide flags remain conservative source inputs and can require a new capture after an otherwise presentation-only edit. These workflows remain required gaps, not exclusions.

Scientific raw-plane identity is qualified on fixed CPU Cycles; general beauty PNG/EXR verification binds source and layout rather than arbitrary image equality. Generic AOV fields must avoid reserved Cycles names. Projected captures require the admitted finite local hierarchy; nested instances/deformers/drivers are refused. Freestyle uses the declared finite Cycles subset. Only complete-timeline rigid-packed and cloth-packed/disk caches are admitted; rigid-disk, inherited arbitrary baked caches, broader simulations, Grease Pencil Line Art, procedural skies and World volumes remain unsupported or unfinished.
